newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.016pts to 102.665.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.016pts to 102.665.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.016 points in Wednesday's trading to 102.665 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortned by 0.222 points to 2.789 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.034 points to 99.608, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio lost 0.163 points to 2.400 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 4.886 points to 1,054.933.
